change_governance.rule: A Pattern Lab workflow addition is unavailable until the typed contract, canonical production skill, scoped agent rules, runbook, workflow-integrity gate, and regression tests all agree.

long_form_rebuild.description: Rebuild and independently verify one retained-narration long-form video for any explicitly configured city. Shorts and thumbnails are excluded.

full_package.description: Build one city-generic, retained-narration release candidate with long form, 3-5 aligned Shorts, three packaging-first thumbnails, toggleable captions, strict 93+ per-asset QA, hashes, and Discord owner review.
